examples.en: Now she was dredging up memories from the depths of her mind.
examples.zh: 这时，她回忆起内心深处的往事。

examples.en: By drilling, geologists can take measurements at various depths.
examples.zh: 通过钻孔，地质学家可以在不同深度测量。

examples.en: Marine life was discovered at depths previously thought to be azoic.
examples.zh: 在先前被认为没有任何生命迹象的海洋深处发现了海洋生物。
